## Core Features

We aim to provide the most immersive and unrestricted AI companion experience.

1. 🧠 Permanent Memory & Independent Saves: Every save has its own permanent memory, so you can freely explore different conversation styles.
2. 💓 In-house Emotion Recognition Model: Automatically judges the emotion behind each AI reply — no more robotic conversations.
3. 👀 Vision & Proactive Screen Peeking: Automatically recognizes your desktop state (working / gaming / idle), and the AI will check in on you.
4. 🐱 Fully Customizable Characters: Import your own OC or a favorite game character and start a conversation that is entirely yours.
5. 🌸 Outfit Switching & Interactions: Swap character outfits, and enjoy playful touches such as petting your character.
6. ✨ Dynamic UI & Immersive Experience: Expressions, motions and speech bubbles change with the AI's emotions, alongside different backgrounds and music.
7. 🎧 Real Voice & Sound Effects: Connect a VITS voice service or dialogue sound effects, and let a whisper speak to your heart.
8. 📜 Multi-character Scripts & Bond System: Import scripts for multi-character conversations, write bond stories for your characters, and unlock achievements.
9. 🍅 Built-in Productivity Tools: A pomodoro timer, schedule and to-do list, with the AI offering thoughtful reminders based on your status.

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 🔧 Prerequisites

> [!NOTE]
> **API key:** Apply for your own API key on the [official DeepSeek platform](https://platform.deepseek.com/) or another LLM provider, and make sure your account has credit.

### 📦 Step 1: Download & Install

1. Choose the build that matches your system:
   - 💻 **Windows 10 64-bit or newer**: download the latest `v0.5`.
   - 💻 **32-bit or older machines**: grab a compatible build from [Issues #379](https://github.com/SlimeBoyOwO/LingChat/issues/379) (for example `LingChat v0.4.0-pre Python3.8 win32.7z`).
2. Download the `LingChat vX.X.X.7z` archive from the [Releases](https://github.com/SlimeBoyOwO/LingChat/releases) page.
3. After installing or extracting, double-click `LingChat.exe` to run it.

> [!WARNING]  
> If `LingChat.exe` disappears after extraction, it was most likely quarantined by Windows Defender. Go to **Windows Security → Virus & threat protection** and allow the file to run.

### ⚙️ Step 2: First-run Configuration

1. Launch the app and click **Start Game**.
2. Open the top-right menu and go to **Advanced Settings**.
3. Click **LLM Provider** in the top-right corner and add your model details: **provider type**, **API Key** and **model name**.
4. Scroll to the bottom, save the configuration and restart — you're good to go!

## 🧩 Extended Feature Setup

<details>
<summary><b>🎧 Setting up VITS voice (click to expand)</b></summary><br>

1. After launching the game, find the voice engine download link under the **Text** section of the menu and download the matching `.7z` build.
2. Extract it, then double-click `..01 启动API服务.bat` (the bundled "start API service" script) to get started.
3. **Performance note**: on integrated graphics or an older machine, generating a single line of speech can take about a minute; a device with a GPU can do it in under a second. Integrated-graphics users who hit a flood of errors may not be able to use this feature.
4. **Using it with custom characters**: to give a custom character a voice, change the `model_name` field in `game_data/characters/<character>/settings.yml` to the name of the model you imported.
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>👁️ Setting up a vision model (click to expand)</b></summary><br>

1. Get a vision model API from Qwen or a similar platform 👉 [Alibaba Cloud vision model API](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?tab=api#/api)
   _(Note: Alibaba Cloud grants free quota by default, which is more than enough for this project.)_
2. In **Settings → Advanced Settings → LLM Management**, assign a vision-capable model to the "vision model" role (the default is "follow the chat model", which reuses your current chat model).
3. Save and restart the app.
4. **How to trigger it**: send “看桌面” or “看看我的桌面” in chat (literally "look at the desktop" / "look at my desktop"). Once proactive chat is configured, the AI can also actively observe what you are doing (_just try not to get caught while playing an eroge *^▽^*_).
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>🧪 Trying the latest build & contributing (click to expand)</b></summary><br>

- We push updates to the [`dev` branch](https://github.com/SlimeBoyOwO/LingChat/tree/dev) at any time and post development logs in [Issues](https://github.com/SlimeBoyOwO/LingChat/issues).
- _Note: development builds may be unstable — bug reports are always welcome!_
</details>

## 🔗 Acknowledgements & Open-source Inspiration

This project would not exist without the pioneers behind these excellent open-source works. Our heartfelt thanks 🌼:

- **[Zcchat](https://github.com/Zao-chen/ZcChat)**: The inspiration for this project, providing the excellent `Vits` models and character assets. (Please go give them a star ❤)
- **[Simple-Vits-API](https://github.com/Artrajz/vits-simple-api)**: Delivers a simple, easy-to-use VITS speech synthesis API.
- **[Style-Bert-VITS2](https://github.com/litagin02/Style-Bert-VITS2)**: Implements Bert-VITS speech synthesis and training — perfect results even with very little data!
- **[ProgrammingVTuberLogos](https://github.com/Aikoyori/ProgrammingVTuberLogos)**: The inspiration for our adorable title style.
- **[Emotion Training](https://github.com/SlimeBoyOwO/Emotion-Model-Trainer)**: The AI model training behind our 18-class short-sentence emotion recognition.
- **[BA-Click-Fx](https://github.com/CialloKing/ba-click-fx)**: Blue Archive particle effects. Very cute.
